notes: Bonds for the Legion water-movers, Cortex pushers, Cortex and Legion artillery and the Armada EMP wing, written to the weave brief.

C.title: Posted notice
beats: Odessa has pegged a strip of cloth to the near bank. Charybdis hovers over it without noticing.
I thought it was a river.
It's a river with a tenant.

B.title: Toll
beats: They cross at the same hour from opposite banks and meet in the middle, neither slowing.
You came in over me. Someone had to be the floor.
Next crossing, I'll take the bank first.

A.title: Shared water
beats: The enemy had mined the shallows and watched the deep. The Telchines and the Charybdis came through the middle, a hand's width apart.
I'll admit it. It's a wide ford.
It's your ford. I just rent the current.
Rent's overdue. Pay it in covering fire.

C.title: Wake and keel
beats: Anvil's Turtles leave a trench in the mud. Charybdis leaves a ripple that is gone by lunch.
I leave room for the next tide.

B.title: Held water
beats: A flooded road. Anvil sat in the middle of it, and the water stacked up behind him like a queue.
I've made a floor. You can use it.
There is no round. That's why I sat.

A.title: Slack tide
beats: The advance stalled at a choke. Anvil held the mouth; Charybdis poured through the gap he left on purpose.
A hand's width. Don't tell anyone.
The tide never tells. It just comes in.

motifs: a door that holds, a bait that leads
eight Grunts against a jammed gate

C.title: Who goes first
beats: Eight Grunts trot to the front of the line. Rusk watches them go with open disapproval.
A door doesn't lead. A door stays.

B.title: Fed to the line
beats: Shiva's Grunts drew the enemy's count while Rusk's gate held the other side. Both sides called it a good day.
You spent your Grunts like coin.
I spent them where they were counted.
I spent six hours at a gate and one lie. I don't count.

A.title: The count
beats: Rusk's gate held; Shiva walked through the middle of it with her Grunts still at her heels.
I opened for the count. You happened to be in it.
Next time, hold the door a second longer. I like the view.

C.title: Distance
beats: Shiva and Cauter reach the same ridge from opposite sides, both certain they were first.

B.title: Argument
beats: They closed on the same position, Grunts spreading, shotguns raised, and nobody agreed who gave the order.
I went on time. You went on paper.

A.title: Both closing
beats: The line broke because two columns arrived from two sides, each sure it had been the second one.
That was ours. Put it in the minutes.
I don't take minutes. I take the ground.

motifs: table of coordinates vs long arc

C.title: Two tables
beats: Lund and Halq share a map. Each has drawn the other's firing line in a different colour.
Your grid is off by a street.
Your spotter is off by a hill.
My spotter is never wrong. He's just slow.

B.title: Same target
beats: Both batteries engaged the same position. The impact fell exactly between their two predictions.
Mine was seen. Yours was guessed.
Guessing is just seeing in advance.

A.title: Firing table
beats: The enemy dug in behind a ridge neither could see over. They fired anyway, from either side.
Your Augur told it where to go. I'd call that a draw.
I'd call it dinner. You're buying.

C.title: Eyes ahead
beats: Spoke's wheeled scouts roll past Lund's Rascals, who are walking.
I like both, as long as they find it first.
I find it. You flatten it. We never need to meet.

B.title: Shown first
beats: A scout returned with a ridge, a bunker, and a time. Lund fired without another word.
You only shell what you've been shown.
It's the only honest way to do it.

A.title: Picture and sound
beats: Spoke's last wheel sat on a hill with the whole valley in it. The Tremor's shells followed his instructions.
I trust what they show me. Today that's enough.
That's more than I give most people.

C.title: Signed
beats: Lund writes her name in the dirt with every volley. Mira's barrage sparkles and her laughter carries across the camp.
They're a contract. You don't cheer at a contract.

B.title: Both loud
beats: The two batteries fired in the same hour. One was careful. One was a parade.
I saw everything. That's the point.

A.title: Different sky
beats: The enemy's line was gone. Lund checked her count. Mira checked the sparkle.
Both can be true. I still sign mine.

motifs: Hearth is the coal of the pad

C.title: Power draw
beats: Cole's generator stands at the edge of the pad. Hearth sits at the middle, steady and warm.
I didn't say I wouldn't borrow.

B.title: Lights on
beats: A brownout rolled across the grid. The Stilettos stayed fuelled. Hearth did not flicker.
Your bombers fly. Mine sits. We each do what we're built for.
Mine eats energy. Yours gives it. Convenient.

A.title: Shared light
beats: The four Stilettos came back to the pad and found it warm. Hearth had kept the light on.
I never leave. It's not waiting.
It felt like waiting. I'll take it.

motifs: EMP wing and a scout who sees by hurting

C.title: Static
beats: Volt's Jaguars paint a target with lightning. Cole's bombers stop it with a pulse.
I see it by hurting it.
I see it by switching it off.

B.title: Both leave a mark
beats: A position with a burn scar and a silence where its guns used to be.
Yours is loud. Between us they never knew where to look.

A.title: Painted and stopped
beats: Volt lit the target. Cole stilled it. Then the Jaguars drove through the quiet.
You light it, I stop it.
You stop it, I make sure it remembers.
Static and burn. We should make it a doctrine.

motifs: a man who owns a circle with guns

C.title: The circle
beats: Stilettos pass overhead. Warder's beamers wait, cloaked, ready to dispute the airspace.
Your guns are about to stop.
They'll start again. I'll still be here.

B.title: Quiet guns
beats: The pulse went through. Every gun on the field stopped mid-sentence, Warder's included.
I switched off everyone's. Yours just resumed first.
I'd like it noted that I was unimpressed.

A.title: Circle and sky
beats: The Stilettos cleared the air above the pad and the Warder's ring held the ground. The enemy found a locked door either way.
Your sky was quiet. I'll allow it.
